CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

2. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Patriarchs Abraham? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Patriarchs Abraham.
   B. Apply the teaching of Bible Patriarchs Abraham with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Bible Patriarchs Abraham has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Bible Patriarchs Abraham to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of The Inspired Word of God? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Inspired Word of God has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Inspired Word of God.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The Inspired Word of God to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of My Family Family members? (1 mark)
   A. Say My Family Family members has no place in daily life.
   B. Use My Family Family members to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Family Family members.
   D. Apply the teaching of My Family Family members with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Self-awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Use Self-awareness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self-awareness.
   C. Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Self-awareness has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Joseph interprets a Dream? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Joseph interprets a Dream.
   B. Say Joseph interprets a Dream has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Joseph interprets a Dream with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Joseph interprets a Dream to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Balaam’s Donkey? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Balaam’s Donkey with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Balaam’s Donkey to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Balaam’s Donkey has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Balaam’s Donkey.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Samson kills a Lion? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Samson kills a Lion.
   B. Use Samson kills a Lion to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Samson kills a Lion has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Samson kills a Lion with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

10. Which response best shows understanding of The Annunciation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Annunciation.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Annunciation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Annunciation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Annunciation has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Attributes of God? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Attributes of God.
   B. Use Attributes of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Attributes of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Attributes of God has no place in daily life.

12. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Inspired Word of God and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Zacchaeus the Tax Collector and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Balaam’s Donkey and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Samson kills a Lion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

2. B — Apply the teaching of Bible Patriarchs Abraham with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. C — Apply the teaching of The Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. D — Apply the teaching of My Family Family members with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Apply the teaching of Joseph interprets a Dream with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A — Apply the teaching of Balaam’s Donkey with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Apply the teaching of Samson kills a Lion with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

10. B — Apply the teaching of The Annunciation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. C — Apply the teaching of Attributes of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Care for the environment and use resources wisely
